note: A composed std-llm trait that a route reaches a wire event from, with no trait listening to that wire event. Controls: a routed wire, an unreached chain, a route in another orbital, a same-named trait of another orbital, a trait without the wire emits.

cases.note: LLM_GENERATE is delivered by a route; the chain reaches LLM_CHAT_WIRE; nothing listens to Llm.LLM_CHAT_WIRE.

findings.message: Llm can emit LLM_CHAT_WIRE (a route delivers an event that leads to it), but no trait in the program listens to Llm.LLM_CHAT_WIRE: the request never leaves the program and the call waits for an answer nothing sends
findings.suggestion: route Llm.LLM_CHAT_WIRE to std-http-request in the composing orbital (HTTP_REQUEST)
